name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: Club officers can set the meeting day in My club.  Members can see it there.  If you can see member names, you can turn on Email me when people join.
After saving a hive, open it right away or tap Add another hive.  You can copy the box setup from another hive in the same yard.
Feed this yard opens the feeding form for the whole yard.  The club Feeding chart is available to download.
A new split starts with today's date.  The mite section can take you straight to an unanswered queen question.
Wingman keeps the form open and shows an error if it can't save a hive because storage is full.
Buddy keeps the number you say after the mite test name.  The earpiece Try it preview releases its audio route when you close it.
Clubs can have up to six officers, including up to two admins.  Inspections have updated Drone Brood and Capped Brood icons.
Sharing word fixes shows the list first.  Untick any words you want to keep private.  Only the words are sent.
Turning Testing logs on or off leaves word learning as you set it.  If learning was off, you can turn Learn from my corrections back on in Settings > Helping Wingman hear you.
Honeycomb Home opens by default.  To use old Home, turn off New Home (try it) in Settings.  Android Back closes its Inspect, Yards and Needs you today boxes.
Problem report emails name any file Wingman couldn't attach.  Buddy has new recorded lines for queen questions and voice help.
